have matrix_mul : ∀ a k b : Ix l,
    matrixUnit B a k * matrixUnit B k b = matrixUnit B a b := by
  intro a k b
  ext u
  simp [matrixUnit, Module.End.mul_apply]
have hAL : divided x (l.toNat - i.val) *
    matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) j = matrixUnit B i j := by
  calc
    _ = divided x (l.toNat - i.val) *
        (matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat) *
          matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) j) := by rw [matrix_mul]
    _ = (divided x (l.toNat - i.val) *
        matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat)) *
          matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) j := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = matrixUnit B i (Fin.last l.toNat) *
          matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) j := by rw [← hP, hA i]
    _ = _ := matrix_mul _ _ _
have hfactor :
    divided x (l.toNat - i.val) *
        (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) *
        divided y (l.toNat - j.val) =
    ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℂ) • matrixUnit B i j := by
  rw [mul_assoc, hY j, mul_smul_comm, hAL]
have hinverse : ∀ (n : ℕ), IsUnit (n : R p) →
    (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ a : R p,
      algebraMap (R p) ℂ a = (n : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
  intro n hn
  rcases hn with ⟨w, hw⟩
  have hwc : algebraMap (R p) ℂ (w : R p) = (n : ℂ) := by
    rw [hw]
    simp
  have hm : (n : ℂ) * algebraMap (R p) ℂ (↑w⁻¹ : R p) = 1 := by
    rw [← hwc, ← map_mul]
    simp
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rw [hz, zero_mul] at hm
    exact zero_ne_one hm
  · refine ⟨↑w⁻¹, ?_⟩
    exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by simpa [mul_comm] using hm)
rcases hinverse (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val) (hunit j) with ⟨hc, a, ha⟩
have hidentity : matrixUnit B i j =
    (((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (divided x (l.toNat - i.val) *
        (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) *
        divided y (l.toNat - j.val)) := by
  rw [hfactor, inv_smul_smul₀ hc]
refine ⟨hidentity, ?_⟩
intro u hu
rcases h_T006.2 with ⟨hiota, hb, hspan, hdiv, hx, hy, hh, hstable, hrest⟩
have hv :
    (divided x (l.toNat - i.val) *
      (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) *
      divided y (l.toNat - j.val)) u ∈ L p M := by
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply]
  exact (hstable (l.toNat - i.val)).1 _ 
    ((hstable l.toNat).2 _
      ((hstable l.toNat).1 _
        ((hstable (l.toNat - j.val)).2 u hu)))
rw [hidentity, LinearMap.smul_apply, ← ha, algebraMap_smul]
exact (L p M).smul_mem a hv

  (∀ j : Ix l, (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) * divided y (l.toNat - j.val) =
    ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℂ) • matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) j) ∧

    (divided x (l.toNat - i.val) * (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) * divided y (l.toNat - j.val)) ∧
  ∀ u ∈ L p M, matrixUnit B i j u ∈ L p M))
